text: Write a PRD for a web app where students book lab slots. The users are students and lab staff. The problem: booking is done on paper and slots get double-booked. Must-have features: book a slot, cancel a slot, and see availability. Constraint: it must work on phones. Success measure: 80% of bookings are made without staff help.

@Requester Everything else in your note is clear.
